$comment: Fingerprints of the digichat Container App inline secrets, NOT values.
Every field here is safe to commit: a SHA-256 and a byte length.
Regenerate or verify with: python scripts/digichat_aca_secret_detector.py
Rotate a secret with `az containerapp secret set` on ONE app at a time, then
re-run the detector to record the new fingerprint. See
docs/ops/digichat-datatap-aca.md section 4 -- never pass --secrets to a promote.
expiry_meaning: Re-verify the fingerprint, rotate, or re-decide the store by this date. Failing the expiry is a detector failure, not a service outage.
